closed_loop.what: Replanning on an online slip estimate against a stop and retry control, 30 m naive routes, 5 slip fields, simulation with a modelled rover (stage 23, post hoc).

label: Facts from the result files of hudasol/dune-rover (SIMULATED BY ME against PUBLISHED data); generated by scripts/build_evidence_card.py

lidar_tests.what: Slip face detector and three class map at 5, 10 and 30 m against one metre USGS 3DEP lidar of North American dune fields (stages 12 and 20). miss: share of cells containing a face of 28 degrees or more (at least 10 square metres) that the map calls TRAVERSABLE; false_safe: share of TRAVERSABLE cells that contain such a face.

slip_models.verdict: no family passes; a slip curve measured for the actual vehicle on the actual sand is needed
slip_models.what: Leave one study out validation of slip model families on digitised published slip against slope curves (stages 15, 21, 22); bar fixed in advance: median held out error at most 0.15.
